title: Knowledge Gateway MCP — knowledge_context Request
description: Phase 0 contract-only, per docs/plans/knowledge-gateway-mcp-proposal.md §9.1. additionalProperties:false plus the explicit absence of provider_weights/cache_level/semantic_threshold/provider_forcing (force_provider)/ranking_policy is the machine-checkable enforcement of §9.1's rule that the public request surface exposes only need-oriented caller options, never provider-internal routing/weighting/threshold controls.

evidence_detail.description: Deliberately open string, not a closed enum — the proposal shows only one example value ('summary') and gives no closed value set. See Design Decision D3.
